summary: Master the art of negotiation with our Purchasing and Contract Negotiation Strategies Course. Gain insights to improve your purchasing decisions and contracts.
lede: Procurement training helps buyers and commercial teams turn sourcing requirements into defensible purchasing decisions. It is for professionals involved in sourcing, supplier evaluation and contract administration who need to compare bids and manage supplier agreements. Learners practise evaluating supplier offers, planning negotiations, and assessing total cost of ownership and contract terms for delivery, payment, warranties and risk.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who handle sourcing decisions, supplier evaluation, commercial negotiation, and contract administration in operational environments.
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic working knowledge of procurement, purchasing, or supplier management. No advanced legal background is required, but familiarity with purchase requests, tenders, supplier quotations, and contract terms will help you complete the exercises more effectively. A laptop is recommended for bid analysis and template work. No coding is required, and the course is delivered at a foundation to intermediate level.
